lines.text: Many learners say: He tells great jokes. He is very sympathetic.
Better: He tells great jokes. He is very nice.
Sympathetic means you feel sorry for someone.

data.wrong: He tells great jokes. He is very sympathetic.
data.right: He tells great jokes. He is very nice.
data.why: Sympathetic means you feel sorry for someone.

quiz.stem: He smiles and tells jokes. He is very ___.
